text.p: Singapore Telecom's paging division launched a new service directing calls from customers' handphones to their pagers, the company said on Friday.
The new service, Mobile-No-Miss, will automatically send a caller's telephone number to a customer's pager when his handphone is busy, unanswered, switched off or when the battery is low.

Moblie-No-Miss, is available to SingTel Mobile Personal Communications Network and Global System Mobile Communications customers at a registration fee of Singapore $10 and a monthly subscription of S$5.
SingTel Mobile registered more than 40,000 new subscribers in May and June and SingTel Paging recorded 90,000, the company said.
